gloss: extent of a decline; size of a drop

definitions.gloss: extent of a decline; size of a drop; margin of decrease
definitions.explanation: How far a price, index, or value has fallen, expressed as an amount or percentage. Standard vocabulary in market and economic reporting.

examples.japanese: {下落幅|げらくはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧になって⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下落幅|げらくはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{縮|ちぢ}まった→縮まる：18725_chijimaru⟧。
examples.english: In the afternoon the stock's decline narrowed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下落幅|げらくはば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: This decline is said to be the largest in the past ten years.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{下落|げらく}→下落：11321_geraku⟧ (a fall in price or value) plus ⟦{幅|はば}→幅：03565_haba⟧ (width, range). ⟦{幅|はば}→幅：03565_haba⟧ here means the size of the movement, the same use as in ⟦{値幅|ねはば}→値幅：28208_nehaba⟧ (price range) and ⟦{上昇幅|じょうしょうはば}→上昇幅：30185_joushouhaba⟧ (extent of a rise).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下落幅|げらくはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: for the decline to be large
- {下落幅|げらくはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{縮|ちぢ}まる→縮まる：18725_chijimaru⟧: for the decline to narrow
- {下落幅|げらくはば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to extend its losses

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上昇幅|じょうしょうはば}→上昇幅：30185_joushouhaba⟧: extent of a rise — the direct opposite
- ⟦{下落率|げらくりつ}→下落率：30147_gerakuritsu⟧: rate of decline — expressed as a percentage rather than an amount
